phases.name: 入站與出站部隊道路相撞

phases.confidence: HIGH_STATIC_FOR_PHASE_AND_LOOP（階段與迴圈高靜態信心）；PARTIAL_FOR_PRODUCTION_MAPPING（正式版對映部分完成）
phases.server_reference: common/src/chunk.rs:196-307. Nested iteration is inbound Vec order then outbound Vec order. Collision uses next-tick progress projections and occurs before inbound arrival handling.
phases.client_production_mapping: Round 8 maps 448→788→522 for the collision path. This establishes structural placement, not identical server/client scheduling.

phases.name: 入站進度、塔抵達、逐支戰鬥與立即塔主寫回

phases.name: 出站鏡像進度與集合壓縮

phases.client_production_mapping: Function 448's force collection update is structurally mapped; exact production/server parity is not runtime-validated.

phases.name: 特殊玩家事件的延遲清理邊界

phases.server_reference: server/src/service.rs:436-457, 502-540. This special-unit consequence is outside the ordinary PvP support subset.
phases.client_production_mapping: No full global-player elimination mapping is claimed for the production client. Ruler cases remain unsupported.

ordering_summary: Per tower: tower timed state/production → Force-vs-Force collision → inbound progress and arrival resolution → outbound progress/removal → Vec compaction.

World traversal: ChunkMap row-major y then x; Chunk towers are enumerated by fixed array index. Within a target tower, inbound and outbound Forces are Vecs, not sorted by Force ID, ETA, owner, source, or destination.
ChunkEvents generated during the world pass are staged, then applied in tick_after_inputs; they do not retroactively run through the already-completed tower pass.
Owner, unit, and battle mutations in an arrival branch are inline. Later arrivals read the updated owner and tower units.
global_pause_countdown: NOT_FOUND_IN_SAVED_SERVER_SOURCE（保存伺服器來源未找到全域暫停倒數）; Tower.delay is a per-tower production/downgrade delay, not a global game pause.
